# New silva-based phylogeny 

```{r }

FASTTREE<-read.tree("~/data/PNG_diet/data/ASV_cleaned_fasttree.nwk")
FASTTREE.tr<-FASTTREE
FASTTREE.tr$edge.length <- sqrt(FASTTREE.tr$edge.length)
ggtree(FASTTREE)
ggtree(FASTTREE.tr)
ggtree(phy_tree(PHS))

PHS.new<-merge_phyloseq(sample_data(PHS),
                        otu_table(PHS),
                        tax_table(PHS),
                        refseq(PHS),
                        FASTTREE)

#relatively moderate reduction of reads
plot(log10(sample_sums(PHS.new)),log10(sample_sums(PHS)))


```

# Sample for analyzes (6 and more sample)

rarefy + transform to proportions

```{r }

#select species with > 5 samples, rerefy and transform
sample_data(PHS.new)$Sp<-sample_data(PHS.new)$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others
names(sample_data(PHS))
SUMM<-summary(as.factor(sample_data(PHS.new)$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others))
SUMM<-SUMM[SUMM>5]
length(SUMM)
PHS.s<-prune_samples(sample_data(PHS.new)$Sp%in%names(SUMM),PHS.new)

PHS.s.sr<-rarefy_even_depth(PHS.s)
PHS.s.sr.t<-transform_sample_counts(PHS.s.sr,function(x) x/sum(x))
PHS.s.sr

```

```{r }

library(rdacca.hp)


WU<-UniFrac(PHS.s.sr,weighted = T,parallel = T)
BC<-vegdist(otu_table(PHS.s.sr))
names(sample_data(PHS.s.sr))

head(sample_data(PHS.s.sr))
unique(sample_data(PHS.s.sr)$Sp)


sample_data(PHS.s.sr)$Group<-ifelse(regexpr("Rattus",sample_data(PHS.s.sr)$Sp)>0,
                                    "Rattus_native","Hydro")
sample_data(PHS.s.sr)$Group<-ifelse(sample_data(PHS.s.sr)$Sp%in%c("Rattus rattus","Rattus exulans"),
                                    "Rattus_invasive", sample_data(PHS.s.sr)$Group)

SD<-data.frame(sample_data(PHS.s.sr))

iv <- data.frame(Sp=SD$Sp,
                Loc=SD$Loc,
                Group=SD$Group,
                Meta=SD$Metalokalita)
iv2 <- data.frame(Sp=SD$Sp,
                Loc=SD$Loc)

#varpart
WU.simple<-rdacca.hp(WU,iv2,method="dbRDA",var.part = TRUE)
plot.rdaccahp(WU.simple,plot.perc = T)

WU.complex<-rdacca.hp(WU,iv,method="dbRDA",var.part = TRUE)
plot.rdaccahp(WU.complex,plot.perc = T)

BC.simple<-rdacca.hp(BC,iv2,method="dbRDA",var.part = TRUE)
plot.rdaccahp(BC.simple,plot.perc = T)

BC.complex<-rdacca.hp(BC,iv,method="dbRDA",var.part = TRUE)
plot.rdaccahp(BC.complex,plot.perc = T)


plot.rdaccahp(WU.simple,plot.perc = T)
plot.rdaccahp(BC.simple,plot.perc = T)

plot.rdaccahp(WU.complex,plot.perc = T)
plot.rdaccahp(BC.complex,plot.perc = T,main="Bray")

```





```{r fig.width=15,fig.height=15}
library(lme4)
# detach("package:lmerTest",unload = T)
# devtools::install_github("jvparidon/lmerMultiMember")
library(lmerMultiMember)
library(plyr)

WU.m<-as.matrix(WU)
WU.m[upper.tri(WU.m,diag = T)]<-NA

BC.m<-as.matrix(BC)
BC.m[upper.tri(BC.m,diag = T)]<-NA

WU.m.l<-reshape2::melt(WU.m)
BC.m.l<-reshape2::melt(BC.m)

head(WU.m.l)

DF<-data.frame(WU=WU.m.l$value,
               BC=BC.m.l$value,
               sample_ID_DF1=WU.m.l$Var1,
               sample_ID_DF2=WU.m.l$Var2)

DF<-DF[!is.na(DF$BC),]
SD1<-SD2<-SD
names(SD1)<-paste0(names(SD1),"_DF1")
names(SD2)<-paste0(names(SD2),"_DF2")

DF<-join(DF,SD1)
DF<-join(DF,SD2)

DF$Sp_dif<-ifelse(DF$Sp_DF1==DF$Sp_DF2,"intraspec","interspec")
DF$Loc_dif<-ifelse(DF$Loc_DF1==DF$Loc_DF2,"Same.loc","Dif.loc")
DF$TEST<-paste0(DF$Sp_dif,"_",DF$Loc_dif)
summary(as.factor(DF$TEST))

ggplot(DF,aes(x=TEST,y=WU))+geom_violin()+geom_boxplot()
ggplot(DF,aes(x=TEST,y=BC^2))+geom_violin()+geom_boxplot()


VECT<-paste(DF$Sp_DF1,DF$Sp_DF2,sep=",")
VECT2<-paste(DF$Loc_DF1,DF$Loc_DF2,sep=",")
MAT<-lmerMultiMember::weights_from_vector(VECT)
MAT2<-lmerMultiMember::weights_from_vector(VECT2)

unique(DF$TEST)
DF$TEST<-factor(DF$TEST,levels=c("intraspec_Same.loc","intraspec_Dif.loc",
                                "interspec_Same.loc","interspec_Dif.loc"     ))

DF$WU.logit<-car::logit(DF$WU)
DF$BC.logit<-car::logit(DF$BC)

m.wu<-lmer(WU.logit ~ TEST+
               (1 | Sp_DF1)+(1|Loc_DF1), memberships = list(Sp_DF1 = MAT,Loc_DF1=MAT2),
             data = DF)
m.wu0<-lmer(WU.logit ~ 1+
               (1 | Sp_DF1)+(1|Loc_DF1), memberships = list(Sp_DF1 = MAT,Loc_DF1=MAT2),
             data = DF)
anova(m.wu,m.wu0)
m.wu.NO.INT<-m.wu

m.bc<-lmer(BC.logit ~ TEST+
               (1 | Sp_DF1)+(1|Loc_DF1), memberships = list(Sp_DF1 = MAT,Loc_DF1=MAT2),
             data = DF)
m.bc0<-lmer(BC.logit ~ 1+
               (1 | Sp_DF1)+(1|Loc_DF1), memberships = list(Sp_DF1 = MAT,Loc_DF1=MAT2),
             data = DF)
anova(m.bc,m.bc0)
m.bc.NO.INT<-m.bc

summary(m.wu)
summary(m.bc)

library(multcomp)
tukey_m.wu <- glht(m.wu, linfct = mcp(TEST = "Tukey"))
tukey_m.bc <- glht(m.bc, linfct = mcp(TEST = "Tukey"))

summary(tukey_m.wu)
summary(tukey_m.bc)

#predictions
library(ggeffects)

pred.wu.ME <- (predict_response(m.wu.NO.INT,terms = c("TEST")))
pred.wu.ME.df<-data.frame(pred.wu.ME)
plot(pred.wu.ME)

pred.bc.ME <- (predict_response(m.bc.NO.INT,terms = c("TEST")))
pred.bc.ME.df<-data.frame(pred.bc.ME)
plot(pred.bc.ME)

pred.wu.ME.df$distance<-"WU"
pred.bc.ME.df$distance<-"BC"

PRED_DF_coo_main<-rbind(pred.wu.ME.df,pred.wu.ME.df)

write.table(PRED_DF_coo_main,file = "~/data/PNG_diet/RESULTS/PRED_DF_coo_main.txt",
            sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F)

```

# Version 2 - interspecific + inter-locality as separate predictor

```{r fig.width=15,fig.height=15}
m.wu<-lmer(WU.logit ~ Sp_dif+Loc_dif+Sp_dif:Loc_dif+
               (1 | Sp_DF1)+(1|Loc_DF1), memberships = list(Sp_DF1 = MAT,Loc_DF1=MAT2),
             data = DF)
m.wu2<-lmer(WU.logit ~ Sp_dif+Loc_dif+
               (1 | Sp_DF1)+(1|Loc_DF1), memberships = list(Sp_DF1 = MAT,Loc_DF1=MAT2),
             data = DF)
anova(m.wu,m.wu2)

m.bc<-lmer(BC.logit ~ Sp_dif+Loc_dif+Sp_dif:Loc_dif+
               (1 | Sp_DF1)+(1|Loc_DF1), memberships = list(Sp_DF1 = MAT,Loc_DF1=MAT2),
             data = DF)
m.bc2<-lmer(BC.logit ~ Sp_dif+Loc_dif+
               (1 | Sp_DF1)+(1|Loc_DF1), memberships = list(Sp_DF1 = MAT,Loc_DF1=MAT2),
             data = DF)
anova(m.bc,m.bc2)

car::Anova(m.wu)
car::Anova(m.bc)


#####################
library(ggeffects)

pred.wu <- (predict_response(m.wu,terms = c("Sp_dif","Loc_dif")))
pred.wu.df<-data.frame(pred.wu)
plot(pred.wu)

pred.bc <- (predict_response(m.bc,terms = c("Sp_dif","Loc_dif")))
pred.bc.df<-data.frame(pred.bc)
plot(pred.bc)


pred.bc.df$distance<-"BC"
pred.wu.df$distance<-"WU"

PRED_DF_coo_inter<-rbind(pred.bc.df,pred.wu.df)

write.table(PRED_DF_coo_inter,file = "~/data/PNG_diet/RESULTS/PRED_DF_coo_inter.txt",
            sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F)

```
